description:
Ideal candidate should have excellent working knowledge in Java back end and good understanding of 
 

 · server-side preprocessors, 
 

 · accessibility and security compliance, 
 

 · User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments and Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system
 

 · Understanding of “session management” in a distributed server environment
 

 · J2EE, Springs, Hibernate etc…
 

 · Knowledge of JavaScript, HTML 5, CSS 3, Jquery, AngularJS, Bootstrap and Node.js is a plus
 

 · Have experience using tools - Git, TFS, Stash, JIRA, Jenkins Should be able to develop, debug code, trouble shoot production issues & apply code fixes. Review code and unit-test application for reliability. Ability to work with remote teams


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
